vibe: Bold, structured chaos, technical, raw, asymmetrical.

headings.style: Massive, high-impact, completely dominates the viewport. No letter-spacing tight for Anton as it is already extremely condensed.

layout.strategy: Asymmetric Bento Grids and Border Collapse (The Technical Look). Elements should have hard 1px or 2px solid black borders to expose the skeleton. Avoid center-alignment; rely on sharp left or right alignment.

components.cards: bg-[#FFFFFF] border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#0A0A0A] transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:translate-x-[-1px] hover:shadow-[10px_10px_0px_#FF3333]
components.buttons: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#FF3333] text-[#FFFFFF] border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] font-['JetBrains_Mono'] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-[#FF3333] transition-all cursor-pointer
components.tags: border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider font-['JetBrains_Mono'] bg-[#F4F4F0] text-[#0A0A0A]
components.nav: fixed top-0 w-full border-b-2 border-[#0A0A0A] bg-[#F4F4F0]/90 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4

rules: No soft fades. Use snappy, mechanical transitions (e.g., ease: [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1], duration: 0.4).
Stagger list items sharply in the grids.
Use massive scrolling marquees for the skills section to create 'Living Texture'.

hero.layout: Grid-based asymmetrical split (e.g., 12 columns: text takes 8, image takes 4, or vice versa).
hero.visuals: Break 'CHANDRA KIRAN KOPPARAPU' into multiple giant lines. Next to it, place the brutalist 3D rendered graphic with a hard black border.
hero.interactions: Slide up text on load. Image has a harsh hover effect (grayscale to color).

about.layout: Two-column asymmetric layout (e.g., md:grid-cols-12). Large heading on the left (col-span-5). Monospaced bio text on the right (col-span-7).
about.style: Raw, honest. Use a solid black border dividing the columns or wrapping the section.

skills.style: Massive outline text (e.g., text-transparent bg-clip-text stroke-black style, or just text-6xl text-[#0A0A0A]) scrolling infinitely using react-fast-marquee. Group tags underneath in a tight flex layout.

projects.layout: Mode A: The Tetris Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Make project cards span different column widths (e.g., col-span-12 for the first featured, col-span-6 for the next two, col-span-4 for smaller ones).
projects.style: Neobrutalist cards. Hard borders, solid shadows. Tech tags visibly separated inside.

publications_certifications.style: Minimalist, technical. Each item is a full-width row with a 2px bottom border border-[#0A0A0A]. On hover, background turns #0A0A0A and text turns #F4F4F0.

contact.style: Text '[12vw]' saying 'LET'S TALK'. Mailto link and social links as oversized brutalist buttons.

hero_background.description: Abstract brutalist 3D render with red neon lines. Extreme contrast.
hero_background.usage: Use in the hero section as a dominant asymmetrical visual element. Apply object-cover and wrap in a div with border-2 border-[#0A0A0A].

texture_overlay.usage: Use as a background image with very low opacity (e.g., opacity-10 or mix-blend-multiply) behind the projects or contact section to break up flat colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the neobrutalist aesthetic: Hard lines (border-2 border-[#0A0A0A]), solid shadows (shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#0A0A0A]), no soft drop shadows.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serif for headings. Import and use 'Anton' for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for body text in index.css.
Ensure all interactive elements have a data-testid attribute for testing (e.g., data-testid='hero-contact-btn').
Build this as a single-page React app (.jsx or .js). No Typescript as per environment constraints.
For the hero section heading, break the name CHANDRA KIRAN KOPPARAPU into multiple lines using large typography (e.g., text-6xl to text-[9vw]).
Integrate 'react-fast-marquee' for a high-energy skills display and install framer-motion, lucide-react.
Do NOT center everything. Rely on grids and asymmetrical balancing.

Implement pure HTML+Tailwind for complex overlapping and grid layouts. Use Shadcn only if absolutely necessary for form/logic, but for this portfolio, standard semantic HTML is preferred for maximum design control.
The layout must be responsive. Use flex-col on mobile, translating to complex grids (grid-cols-12) on md/lg screens.
